manifest.description: Search the public web for up-to-date documentation, repositories, news, or facts and return ranked titles, URLs, and text highlights. Follow up with web_fetch when full page details are needed.

query.description: Natural-language search query describing the topic, documentation, repository, or facts to find.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of search results to return (default 5, maximum 10).

objective.description: Optional research goal specifying which sources should rank first or what concrete facts to focus on.

includeDomains.description: Optional list of domains to focus search results on (e.g. ["github.com", "agentclientprotocol.com"]).
